definition.eyebrow: WHAT IS AN AI EMPLOYEE OR AI AGENT
definition.title: An AI Employee is an AI agent specialized in a defined business job.
definition.body: An AI Employee is an AI agent configured for a concrete business role. It receives work, checks authorized information, uses approved tools, executes or prepares actions within explicit boundaries and asks for human intervention when a decision exceeds its authority.

workflow.title: One problem can move across several employees without losing the process context.
workflow.description: Educational example: a customer detects an invoice error and asks to cancel an order. Work moves through the right profiles and pauses for approval when policy requires it.

steps.title: Support receives
steps.text: Understands the request and checks customer and order context.

steps.title: Accounting validates
steps.text: Checks the invoice and identifies the discrepancy.

steps.title: Administration corrects
steps.text: Prepares or updates the permitted record.

steps.title: Human approves
steps.text: Cancellation pauses when authorization is required.

steps.title: Support resolves
steps.text: Communicates the result and closes the case.

workflow.disclaimer: Illustrative scenario using synthetic data. Real authority depends on the configuration, integrations and policies of each deployment.

faq.title: Understand IA Empleado without ambiguous language.

items.question: What is an AI Employee or AI agent for business?
items.answer: It is an AI agent configured for a defined business role with objectives, tools, permissions, policies and supervision. It can work with business systems and perform bounded tasks under explicit rules; it is not simply a chatbot with a job title.

items.question: Can AI Employees work with each other?
items.answer: The product vision includes teams of specialized profiles coordinating tasks and structured context. The concrete availability of each workflow depends on implemented and validated capabilities and integrations.

items.question: Can it connect to my company systems?
items.answer: The platform is designed to integrate systems such as CRM, ERP, email, calendar, ecommerce, ticketing, documents and APIs through scoped connectors and permissions.

items.question: Does AI make every decision automatically?
items.answer: No. Important actions can require deterministic rules and human approval. Autonomy is configured and never means authority without limits.

items.question: Can it be installed privately?
items.answer: The architecture is designed to allow production in customer-controlled infrastructure or a dedicated private environment, depending on deployment scope.
